subject: Post-demo: procurement & invoice requirements for PayLane
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Caleb Turner <caleb.turner@paylane.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 28 Oct 2025 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo: procurement & invoice requirements for PayLane

Hi Caleb —

Thanks again for taking the demo today. Quick recap and next steps so we have a clean path to get you live:

- Redwood plan we reviewed: Dedicated 2xA100 equivalent pool (monthly commitment) + pay-as-you-go overage.
- Technical blocker: none identified; your infra team is comfortable with VPC peering / static IPs.
- Procurement items we discussed: PO vs card, net terms, invoice format, and tax/VAT rules.

To help our Sales Ops and Finance move this through quickly, can you confirm the following on your side?
1) Procurement path: will PayLane issue a formal PO, or do you expect to pay on corporate card initially?
2) Net terms preferred (Net 30/45/60)?
3) Billing information for the invoice (legal entity name, billing address, tax ID / VAT if applicable).
4) Any specific invoice format requirements (line-item breakdown, order number, cost center code)?
5) Are you interested in purchasing via a marketplace (AWS Marketplace / Azure Marketplace) instead of a direct PO?

I can pull together a one-page commercial summary and the standard PO template we accept. If you prefer, Marissa (cc'd) can loop in Finance to review W9 and contract redlines.

Target: get PO in hand and a signed SOW/quote by the end of next week so engineering can schedule dedicated capacity.

Thanks — let me know the answers and I’ll prep the docs.

— Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference

From: Caleb Turner <caleb.turner@paylane.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Asha Kumari <asha.k@paylane.com>
Date: Wed, 29 Oct 2025 09:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo: procurement & invoice requirements for PayLane

Vivek —

Great demo, thanks. Answers inline below:

1) Procurement path: We prefer to route via PO for committed spend. We can start with a PO for the monthly commitment and keep card on file for any small immediate charges during onboarding.
2) Net terms: Net 30 is our standard; exceptions require CFO sign-off and take ~2 weeks.
3) Billing info (legal entity): PayLane Payments, Inc.
   Billing address: 1201 Market Street, Suite 2200, San Francisco, CA 94103
   Tax ID (EIN): 45-6789123
4) Invoice format: Our AP system needs line-item breakdowns (subscription, setup, overage) and a PO number field. If you can include a cost center field that would help.
5) Marketplace: Not currently — we prefer direct procurement for now.

We also need a W9 and the Redwood PO template for our procurement team to attach. If you can send a PDF of your standard quote with the SKU breakdown that will speed approvals.

Cheers,
Caleb
Caleb Turner
Head of Procurement, PayLane
caleb.turner@paylane.com
+1 (415) 222-3344

Thanks for the clear responses. Looping in Monica from Finance to confirm the invoice and tax items and to share the documents you requested.

Date: Mon, 2 Nov 2025 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo: procurement & invoice requirements for PayLane

Caleb —

Thanks — finance confirms we can do Net 30 for the committed monthly amount on DL-2025-1179. A couple of quick notes for AP to ensure smooth processing:

- Send PO to sales@redwood.com with PO number in the subject and the billing contact cc'd (accounting@paylane.com).
- Invoice will be issued monthly in PDF to accounting@paylane.com; we will include line items: subscription fee, setup, and any overage. Each invoice will contain a separate section for tax where applicable.
- Redwood requires the legal entity and billing address exactly as you provided; please make sure the PO matches that formatting.
- For US customers we do not apply VAT; state sales tax will be applied only if Redwood has nexus in that state. If PayLane is tax-exempt, please provide the exemption certificate.

I attached our standard invoice template (redwood_invoice_template.pdf) and the signed quote. Once we have the executed PO from PayLane, we will finalize the start date and issue the first invoice.

Monica Patel
Finance Operations | Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.com
